title: 7YY SVG ligand reconstruction with hidden atom-label audit
summary: Reconstruct the sourced 7YY ligand from a visible structure SVG, report chemical invariants, and provide a dependency-free parser that generalizes to a hidden halogen mutation.
agentMustDo: Write output/submission.json with a valid 7YY SMILES and invariants
Write executable output/solve.py that parses an arbitrary supplied SVG
evaluation: Hard gates reject missing files, malformed JSON, extra keys, hash mismatch, wrong atom inventory, invalid SMILES, and missing/non-executable solve.py. Score rubric: schema/hash 0.15, chemical identity 0.35, formula/heavy-atom/ring/SMILES cross-checks 0.30, hidden mutation parser 0.20. Missing or malformed output returns 0.0. The hidden SVG changes one F label to Br; solve.py must parse labels and may not embed either sourced SMILES literal. The pass threshold is 0.95; a visible-only hard-coded solver scores 0.80 and does not pass.
